series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_style_standard: Adult cinematic physically realistic 3D historical reconstruction & live-action 65mm location cinematography (ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo primes, Kodak Vision3 500T grade: warm sandstone highlights, muted earth/stone/bronze midtones, deep ink-navy shadows)

scenes.shot_type: Jagged Bleached-Limestone Peaks & Bone-Strewn Defile of the Bone Mountains (28mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm low-angle mountain wide: colossal jagged Bone Mountains grazed by warm sandstone sun above brooding ink-navy storm clouds & bone-strewn rocky defile

scenes.shot_type: Over-the-Shoulder View Into Bone-Strewn Gorge & Cliff-Fortress of Hyrkoon (40mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm over-the-shoulder depth shot: wool-cloaked Bronze-Age traveler overlooking sheer bone-strewn chasm & watchfire-lit cliff-carved fortress-gate of Hyrkoon

scenes.shot_type: Stone Causeway & Bastion Gate of Hyrkoon Opening Toward Eastern Essos (28mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm deep-focus pass wide: battered stone bastion walls, bronze-shielded sentries & flaming braziers of Hyrkoon opening onto misty emerald eastern valleys

scenes.shot_type: Ancient Tiered Cedar-and-Stone Archive Temple Complex of Early Yi Ti (24mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm hillside ultra-wide: multi-tiered ancient cedar-and-stone archive pavilions of Yi Ti rising above misty karst river valleys under warm sandstone sunbeams

scenes.shot_type: Elderly YiTish Scholar-Priests Unrolling Tied Bamboo-Slip Annals by Bronze Ding (50mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm archive sanctuary medium close-up: two saffron-and-indigo-robed YiTish scholar-priests unrolling bamboo-slip annals beside smoking bronze cauldron & oil-lamp

scenes.shot_type: Lantern-Lit Cracked Temple Mural of the Primordial Great Empire of the Dawn (35mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm gallery tracking wide: aged YiTish priest with brass lantern passing cracked gold-leaf & mineral-pigment wall mural of stepped Dawn-Empire palaces

scenes.shot_type: Shattered Dawn-Empire Sun-Disk Courtyard Under Advancing Storm Wall (65mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm telephoto courtyard: split geometric pale-jade sun-disk monument & overturned smoking braziers before cyclopean palace colonnades under black storm wall

scenes.shot_type: Overturned Pale-Jade Goblet, Spilled Crimson & Wind-Whipped Palace Tapestries (50mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm low-angle palace chamber study: overturned carved pale-jade goblet, spilled dark crimson & billowing tapestries beside glowing iron floor-brazier

scenes.shot_type: Usurping Bloodstone Emperor Claiming Fallen Amethyst Diadem on Throne Dais (35mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm throne-hall wide: stern Bloodstone Emperor in dark charcoal-garnet robes & bronze shoulder-plates claiming fallen amethyst diadem between smoking dragon-braziers

scenes.shot_type: Fallen Amethyst Empress on Palace Terrace Under Solar Eclipse & Advancing Night (24mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm palace colonnade ultra-wide: fallen Amethyst Empress & amethyst hairpin on stone steps as total solar eclipse & ink-navy night wall swallow eastern horizon
